### The Low Power Programmable Leader

## OUR PRODUCTS

Lattice low power FPGAs and easy-to-use software tools enable designers to innovate and reduce
development time for their Industrial, Automotive, Communications, Computing, and Consumer
applications.
[[TDQ-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][211]
**Lattice MachXO5-NX TDQ ** is industry’s first secure control FPGA with full CNSA 2.0 compliant and
post-quantum cryptography (PQC) support.
[[Product-Selector-Guide1]][212]
[Lattice FPGA Product Selector Guide][213] provides a quick and easy way to identify Lattice FPGA
devices, features, and specifications.
[[CrossLinkU-Board-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][214]
**CrossLinkU-NX Evaluation Board** is a platform for general purpose application development using
CrossLinkU-NX device, the first FPGA with hard USB2/3 (5Gbps) interface.
[ EXPLORE OUR PRODUCTS][215]

## OUR SOLUTION STACKS

Whether you're designing for a smart factory, advanced driver experiences, AI datacenters,
leading-edge telecom infrastructure, or connected home, Lattice Solution Stacks allow you to quickly
unleash your innovation.
[[Sentry-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][216]
The **Lattice Sentry solution stack** enables a cyber resilient and NIST SP 800-193 compliant PFR
solution with easy-to-use FPGA design tools and a full suite of custom design services.
[[mVision-356x208-thumbnail]][217]
The **Lattice mVision solution stack ** helps embedded vision system designers to evaluate, develop,
and deploy FPGA-based embedded vision applications, such as machine vision, robotics, ADAS, video
surveillance, and drones.
[[sensAI-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][218]
The **Lattice sensAI solution stack** includes everything you need to evaluate, develop, and deploy
FPGA-based Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence solutions.
[ EXPLORE MORE SOLUTIONS][219]

### The Low Power Programmable Leader

## OUR PRODUCTS

Lattice low power FPGAs and easy-to-use software tools enable designers to innovate and reduce
development time for their Industrial, Automotive, Communications, Computing, and Consumer
applications.
[[TDQ-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][211]
**Lattice MachXO5-NX TDQ ** is industry’s first secure control FPGA with full CNSA 2.0 compliant and
post-quantum cryptography (PQC) support.
[[Product-Selector-Guide1]][212]
[Lattice FPGA Product Selector Guide][213] provides a quick and easy way to identify Lattice FPGA
devices, features, and specifications.
[[CrossLinkU-Board-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][214]
**CrossLinkU-NX Evaluation Board** is a platform for general purpose application development using
CrossLinkU-NX device, the first FPGA with hard USB2/3 (5Gbps) interface.
[ EXPLORE OUR PRODUCTS][215]

## OUR SOLUTION STACKS

Whether you're designing for a smart factory, advanced driver experiences, AI datacenters,
leading-edge telecom infrastructure, or connected home, Lattice Solution Stacks allow you to quickly
unleash your innovation.
[[Sentry-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][216]
The **Lattice Sentry solution stack** enables a cyber resilient and NIST SP 800-193 compliant PFR
solution with easy-to-use FPGA design tools and a full suite of custom design services.
[[mVision-356x208-thumbnail]][217]
The **Lattice mVision solution stack ** helps embedded vision system designers to evaluate, develop,
and deploy FPGA-based embedded vision applications, such as machine vision, robotics, ADAS, video
surveillance, and drones.
[[sensAI-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][218]
The **Lattice sensAI solution stack** includes everything you need to evaluate, develop, and deploy
FPGA-based Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence solutions.
[ EXPLORE MORE SOLUTIONS][219]

whereas a logarithmic-qubit approach offers a reduced representation cost of [latex]\mathcal{O}(\log
D)[/latex] and better compatibility with available near-term technology.]

consistently surpassing external reward models across multiple benchmarks.]

conventional security paradigms.]

systems, and reservoir computing to safeguard digital images.*

*A new system enables robots to perform complex dexterous tasks by learning directly from egocentric

14.07.2026 by [avetissian][28]

[The system employs a two-stage process for question answering with long contexts: initially, a base
language model identifies question-relevant spans within the provided context, and subsequently,
these extracted spans are utilized for targeted text-to-text transfer, enabling answer generation
conditioned on both the full original context and the specific question posed, rather than relying
solely on potentially noisy or irrelevant information within the entire document.]

focusing on the most relevant parts of lengthy inputs.*

Categories [Artificial Intelligence][29]

## [Tuning Light with AI: A Universal Calibration Framework][30]

13.07.2026 by [avetissian][31]

[Photonic processors leverage Mach-Zehnder interferometers to perform unitary transformations
essential for advanced computing and signal processing, but achieving optimal performance
necessitates sophisticated calibration methods; tandem neural networks address inherent ambiguities
in these systems by first learning hardware imperfections and then predicting precise control
currents needed to realize desired optical responses - effectively resolving the many-to-one problem
common in photonic mesh designs.]

*Researchers have developed an artificial intelligence-powered system that dramatically improves the
precision and adaptability of programmable photonic processors.*

Categories [Quantum Physics][32]

13.07.2026 by [avetissian][34]

model-initially pre-trained on large-scale spatio-temporal data to instill world knowledge and align
visual information with language, then refined through multi-task learning and synthetic data to
achieve seamless transfer between simulation and reality, exhibiting emergent behaviors beyond the
capabilities of traditional, task-specific computer vision systems.]

*New research demonstrates that training models to create video from text unlocks surprisingly broad
capabilities in computer vision.*

# Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonic Chip Foundry

## Your Partner for Scalable TFLN Photonic Chips

CCRAFT is a Swiss-based photonic chip foundry committed to advancing high-performance thin-film
lithium niobate (TFLN) technology for scalable, high-volume manufacturing. Built on over six years
of pioneering R&D at CSEM (the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology), we deliver
rigorously tested and proven integrated photonic solutions from our in-house facility.

[Learn more about CCRAFT][31]

* Independent and innovative foundry located in the heart of Europe
* Confidentiality

### Telecom & Datacom

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6

TFLN EO modulators transform high-speed optical communication with data rates exceeding 400 Gbit/s,
positioning them as essential for next-generation telecom and datacom systems. Their
multi-wavelength and low-power operation across O-band, C-band, L-band, and S-band enhance DWDM
system efficiency, supporting both short-distance intra-datacenter links and long-haul
communication. CMOS integration enables compact, energy-efficient transceiver designs, ideal for
high-port interconnects and rack-to-rack connectivity. Integrated EO polarization controllers and
tunable filters further boost bandwidth and spectral efficiency, addressing the needs of modern
high-performance networks.

### High-Performance Computing & AI

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

AI and HPC systems require unprecedented data transmission speeds, but current interconnect
technologies have reached their fundamental limits. TFLN EO modulators address this challenge with
ultrafast, low-power optical modulation and simplified electronics, enabling seamless GPU-to-GPU and
node-to-node communication. Designed for next-generation AI and HPC architectures, TFLN integrates
effortlessly with advanced packaging technologies such as co-packaged optics and 3D chip stacking.
These innovations enable scalable, low-latency solutions that are critical for accelerating AI
training, inference, and high-performance computing workloads.

### Quantum Technologies

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

Photonic engines for atomic systems (e.g., ion trapping, atomic clocks) operating in visible and NIR
wavelengths; Ultra-fast pulse generation, pure phase modulation, and low-loss performance for
quantum control; Quantum communication: entangled photon pair generation, polarization control, and
EO gating; Photonic quantum computing: programmable MZI meshes, cluster states, and squeezed light
sources.

CMOS-compatible integration for compact, deployable systems; Dielectric resilience to high

# Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonic Chip Foundry

## Your Partner for Scalable TFLN Photonic Chips

CCRAFT is a Swiss-based photonic chip foundry committed to advancing high-performance thin-film
lithium niobate (TFLN) technology for scalable, high-volume manufacturing. Built on over six years
of pioneering R&D at CSEM (the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology), we deliver
rigorously tested and proven integrated photonic solutions from our in-house facility.

* MPW and custom RUNs (3-4 RUNs / year)

* Confidentiality
   

## Transforming Industries with TFLN PICs

### Telecom & Datacom

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

TFLN EO modulators transform high-speed optical communication with data rates exceeding 400 Gbit/s,
positioning them as essential for next-generation telecom and datacom systems. Their
multi-wavelength and low-power operation across O-band, C-band, L-band, and S-band enhance DWDM
system efficiency, supporting both short-distance intra-datacenter links and long-haul
communication. CMOS integration enables compact, energy-efficient transceiver designs, ideal for
high-port interconnects and rack-to-rack connectivity. Integrated EO polarization controllers and
tunable filters further boost bandwidth and spectral efficiency, addressing the needs of modern
high-performance networks.

### High-Performance Computing & AI

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

AI and HPC systems require unprecedented data transmission speeds, but current interconnect
technologies have reached their fundamental limits. TFLN EO modulators address this challenge with
ultrafast, low-power optical modulation and simplified electronics, enabling seamless GPU-to-GPU and
node-to-node communication. Designed for next-generation AI and HPC architectures, TFLN integrates
effortlessly with advanced packaging technologies such as co-packaged optics and 3D chip stacking.
These innovations enable scalable, low-latency solutions that are critical for accelerating AI
training, inference, and high-performance computing workloads.

### Quantum Technologies

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

Photonic engines for atomic systems (e.g., ion trapping, atomic clocks) operating in visible and NIR
wavelengths; Ultra-fast pulse generation, pure phase modulation, and low-loss performance for
quantum control; Quantum communication: entangled photon pair generation, polarization control, and
EO gating; Photonic quantum computing: programmable MZI meshes, cluster states, and squeezed light
sources.

### Space Applications

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

Low-power, lightweight PICs for satellite-to-satellite, satellite-to-ground, and intra-payload
communication; High-power handling for free-space communication and advanced LiDAR systems;
CMOS-compatible integration for compact, deployable systems; Dielectric resilience to high
temperatures, radiation, and electromagnetic interference.

### Sensing & Spectroscopy

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

Multi-wavelength operation for biomonitoring, Raman spectroscopy, and environmental monitoring;
Nonlinear wavelength generation for mid-IR sensing using SHG and DFG processes; Advanced LiDAR: fast
beam steering, low-power phase shifters, and multi-spectral functionality; Frequency comb generation
for precision spectroscopy, including astro-combs for exoplanet detection; Opto-mechanical sensing,
gyros, and evanescent field sensing using low-loss waveguides; Nonlinear photonics for metrology,
OCT, holography, and other precision tools.

### Optical Computing

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

Wavelength conversion and generation via PPLN waveguides for optical transistors; Ultra-fast,
low-power EO modulators for agile optical signal processing; High-quality delay lines and resonators
for agile processor architectures; Neuromorphic computing powered by low-loss, nonlinear components;
Programmable photonics with reconfigurable MZI meshes and wavelength converters.

### Microwave Photonics

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

Ultra-fast EO modulators for seamless microwave-to-optical signal conversion; Integrated delay lines
and high-frequency filters for 5G/6G application; Low-loss waveguides for precise signal
manipulation and high-frequency transmission.

### 5G/6G & IoT

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

High-frequency EO modulators enable low-latency, high-bandwidth data transfer; Energy-efficient,
low-power components ensure sustainable IoT operation; Multi-wavelength DWDM for compact, scalable
IoT networks; Robust, CMOS-compatible designs for edge and smart device integration.

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

* [Double BBO Crystal Pockels Cells]
  
  ### [Double BBO Crystal Pockels Cells][94]
  
  We are experts in the field of Double BBO Crystal Pockels Cells. BBO-based Pockels Cell are used
  to change the polarization state of light passing through it when an voltage is applied to the
  electrodes of BBO Electro-optic Components. Typical applications include Q-switching of the laser
  cavity, laser cavity dumping and coupling light into and from regenerative amplifiers. Low
  piezoelectric ringing makes BBO Pockels Cells attractive for the control of high-power and high
  repetition rate lasers. Fast switching electronic drivers properly matched to the cell are
  available for Q-switches , cavity dumping and other applications.
* [Double DKDP (KD*P) Crystal Electro-Optical Cell]
  
  ### [Double DKDP (KD*P) Crystal Electro-Optical Cell][95]
  
  Our Double DKDP (KD*P) Crystal Electro-Optical Cell products have been recognized by our customers
  with advanced production technology and good quality.

  field of Potassium Titanyl Phosphate KTP EO Q-Switch. Potassium TitanyI Phosphahe KTP Pockels Cell
  , which consists of 2 pcs of H-KTP crystal, has very low quarter wave voltage. Coupletech use
  hydrothermal-grown KTP crystal, which overcome the common electrochromicm damage of the flux-grown
  KTP Crystals, KTP Pockels Cells have high resistivity and high damage threshold. H-KTP is suitable
  for making electro-optic devices with excellent properties. Typical application is Q-switching,
  Pulse picking, E-O Modulator, etc.

Coupletech Co., Ltd., manufactures, develops and markets a variety of optical crystals and devices
which are widely used in the field of optoelectronics, Coupletech product line consists of laser
crystals including Nd:YVO4, Diffusion Bonded Composite Crystal, Nd:YLF, Cr:YAG, etc.; Nonlinear
optical ( NLO ) crystals, including KTP, KTA, BIBO, LBO, BBO, DKDP, KDP crystal, etc.; Fluoride
crystals including CaF2, BaF2, MgF2; Crystal devices including DKDP Q-Switch, LN Q-Switch, BBO

exceptionally low insertion loss and broad bandwidth devices.

About Us

# A better world with photonics

G&H delivers advanced photonics engineering and manufacturing solutions for industrial, telecoms,
aerospace, defense, space, quantum, and life sciences applications.

[Find Out More][60]Explore
[A technician in a cleanroom gown, hair net, and safety glasses uses a microscope to inspect a
precision optical component on a metal fixture in a laboratory setting.]
Solutions

## Enabling **market solutions** for core applications

We focus our photonics expertise in designing, engineering and manufacturing to provide our OEM
customers with the solutions they need. Whatever the application or environment, we can work with
you to enable greater system efficiency and effectiveness.

[

### Aerospace and Defense

In harsh aerospace and defense environments there are no second chances. Mission-critical technology
demands uncompromising precision, absolute reliability, and close partnerships with suppliers.

Find out more
][61]
[

### Industrial and Telecom

Photonics technology is crucial in many fields, from laser based manufacturing to subsea
communication to energy infrastructure. Optimum performance relies on solutions of the highest
quality, reliability and durability.

Find out more
][62]
[

### Life Sciences

As medical innovation accelerates so do the demands on technology. Our solutions for life sciences
are enabling developments in diagnostic, analytic, surgical, therapeutic and drug delivery devices.

Find out more
][63]
Our Business

## G&H our business

Watch our video to discover how our people, photonics technologies and global manufacturing
capabilities support customers across Industrial, Aerospace & Defence, and Life Sciences markets.

[Watch now][64]
Products

## Explore our extensive **product** range

The G&H photonics products range includes acousto, electro, fiber and precision optic technologies.
Over 70 years’ experience, unique expertise, world-class facilities and a commitment to working in
partnership, enable us to deliver the highest quality components and optical systems.

[View All Products][65]
[

### Acousto-Optics

Unmatched optical power handling and optical performance. Delivered consistently over time and in
volume.

Find out more][66]
[

### Crystal Optics

High-optical throughput and precise phase control. A wide selection of homegrown crystal boules and
materials are available.

Find out more][67]
[

### Electro-Optics

Minimized drive voltages and high pulse rate operation. Complete and customised system designs.

Find out more][68]
[

### Fiber Optics

G&H fiber optics, optimal performance and reliability. Qualified and deployed in many harsh
environments.

Find out more][69]
[

### Precision Optics

Precision optical components for applications that require high-quality custom optics.

Find out more][70]
[

### Polymer Optics

Polymer Optics lightweight, cost-effective, precision-molded optical solutions for diverse
applications worldwide.

Find out more][71]
[

### Optical Coatings & Filters

High-performance optical coatings and filters engineered to enhance transmission, reflection, and
durability.

Find out more][72]
[

### Lens Systems

Unique cutting-edge optical solutions and lens assemblies for a diverse customer base and a
staggering range of applications.

Find out more][73]
[

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

國立陽明交通大學半導體工程學系與之光半導體（Latitude Design Systems, LDS）今日展開學術合作，捐贈 50
套光電晶片與系統設計整合平台 PIC
Studio予國立陽明交通大學半導體工程學系，導入半導體工程學系之教學與學術研究。PIC Studio
強調系統級設計，能支援異質整合架構下光晶片與電晶片的交互整合，並可一併考量先進封裝寄生效應、均衡演算
法與光纖模型等，提供從元件到系統級的端到端模擬與設計流程，可協助學生理解資料先進中心光互連與光晶片設
計，並進一步強化教師教學、前瞻研究與跨域人才培育。 隨著 AI
基礎建設、高速光互連與先進半導體應用持續受到高度關注，光電晶片設計能力正成為新一代半導體人才培育的重
要方向之一。相較於傳統單一領域訓練，光電晶片設計涉及光學、元件物理、電路設計、系統模擬與製程整合等多
面向能力，也使產學合作在課程設計、研究導入與實務銜接上扮演更關鍵的角色。

###### telecommunications, and sensing applications.

###### Unique Schematic-Driven Layout for Efficient Design

designed for specialty semiconductor chip design. Our offerings include research and development
services, as well as foundry process design kits (PDKs).

The main business of the company is the production of magnesium oxide, magnesium carbonate,
magnesium sulfate, magnesium hydroxide and other magnesium salt products and services.

The products are mainly used in medicine and food, metal refining, electronic materials, rubber and
plastic, composite materials, optical glass, aerospace, military nuclear industry, auto parts, 5G
new materials and other industries.

### [OptiSystem: Comprehensive Optical System Design Software][23]

OptiSystem is a comprehensive software design suite that enables users to plan, test, and simulate
optical links in the transmission layer of modern optical networks.

### [OptiSPICE: Optoelectronic Circuit Simulation][24]

OptiSPICE is the first circuit design software for analysis of integrated circuits including
interactions of optical and electronic components. It allows for the design and simulation of
opto-electronic circuits at the transistor level, from laser drivers to transimpedance amplifiers,
optical interconnects and electronic equalizers.

### [OptiFDTD: FDTD Design and Analysis for Photonic Components][25]

OptiFDTD is a powerful, highly integrated, and user friendly CAD environment that enables the design
and simulation of advanced passive and non-linear photonic components.

### [OptiInstrument: Optical System Measurement and Testing][26]

OptiInstrument is designed to addresses the needs of researchers, scientists, photonic engineers,
professors and students who are working with instruments.

### [OptiBPM: Optical Waveguide Design][27]

OptiBPM is a comprehensive CAD environment used for the design of complex optical waveguides.
Perform guiding, coupling, switching, splitting, multiplexing, and demultiplexing of optical signals
in photonic devices.

### [OptiFiber: Cutting-edge Optical Fiber Design][28]

The optimal design of a given optical communication system depends directly on the choice of fiber
parameters. OptiFiber uses numerical mode solvers and other models specialized to fibers for
calculating dispersion, losses, birefringence, and PMD.

Emerging as a de facto standard over the last decade, OptiGrating has delivered powerful and user
friendly design software for modeling integrated and fiber optic devices that incorporate optical

# Room-Temperature Wafer Bonding for Next-Generation Photonics

Partow Technologies enables next-generation heterogeneous integration through advanced
room-temperature Surface Activated Bonding (SAB) and thin-film transfer technologies. Our platform
supports the integration of lithium niobate, GaN, SiC, diamond, and other advanced materials for
high-performance photonic, RF, quantum, and semiconductor applications.

By eliminating the need for high-temperature bonding, Partow’s SAB technology reduces thermal
stress, preserves material integrity, and enables scalable integration of dissimilar materials that
are difficult or impossible to combine using conventional processes.

Our technologies support a broad range of emerging applications, including AI datacenter photonics,
optical interconnects, electro-optic sensing, microwave photonics, THz systems, quantum photonics,
and advanced power electronics.

## Our Leadership

##  

## Payam Rabie, Ph.D.

## Founder & CEO

## Dr. Payam Rabie founded Partow Technologies to advance next-generation semiconductor and photonic
## manufacturing. He leads the company's strategy, product development, and commercialization, with
## a focus on innovative room-temperature wafer bonding technologies and thin-film lithium niobate
## (TFLN) photonic integrated circuit (PIC) platforms.

## About Us

## Our Capabilities

Partow provides expertise across the full integration stack, including:
* Surface Activated Wafer Bonding
* Ion-Sliced Thin-Film Transfer
* Thin-Film Lithium Niobate (TFLN)
* Heterogeneous Photonic Integration
* Advanced Wafer Engineering
* Electro-Optic Devices and Sensors

Our capabilities include wafer-scale bonding, photonic device fabrication, process development, and
custom substrate engineering for research, defense, and commercial markets.

Partow Technologies is advancing the future of photonic and semiconductor integration through
scalable, low-temperature manufacturing solutions for next-generation systems.

#### Press
* Partow Technologies will showcase its room-temperature wafer bonding solution at IWGO 2026, August
  2–7, in College Park, Maryland. Visit us at Exhibit Space #14.
* [Feb 2026, "Electro-optic THZ emitter and receiver devices and method of fabrication", has been
  officially granted. Patent No.: US12,547,048B1][7]
* Feb 2026, Partow's EO Sensor Enables Breakthrough Accelerator Sensor Technology at Argonne
  Facility (ANL)
* Jan 2026, Partow will be in Photonics West 2026, January 20-22 in San Francisco. Booth 2367
* Oct 2025, Join Partow at SEMICON West 2025, October 7–9 in Phoenix, Arizona, at booth #5482
* Feb 2025, Partow received SBIR phase I award to develop Electro-optic sensors for non-destructive
  electron beam diagnostics for DOE
* Feb 2024, Partow received STTR phase II award to develop UHV room-temperature wafer bonding system
  for DOD.
* August 2024, "Electro-optic electric field sensor and method of fabrication", has been officially
  granted. Patent No.: US 11,815,747
* [New Paper on TFLN based EO electric field sensors][8]
* [New Paper on TFLN based THz wave detector][9]

### Research Community

Follow global scholars in real time and build close social networks.

[Learn More][56]

## Exclusive access

Peeref offers a wide range of exclusive features for reviewers and journal editors. Please sign in
to access these features.

### Reviewer Community

Reviewers registered at Peeref will be more likely to receive peer-review invitations, and can
easily share their review experience with peers. Peeref provides free reviewer training programs and
other resources to help reviewers enhance their academic profiles.

We sincerely invite editors from academic journals around the world to register at Peeref—where
journals can showcase academic achievements, promote high-quality publications to a much wider
audience of researchers, and enhance international impact.

innovative solutions to their unique needs.

ProChem’s team focuses on personal and quick responses to orders and quotation requests to ensure
the customer is getting exactly what they need for their processes. As a versatile manufacturing
company, we are always expanding our products to meet our customer's exact requirements. Our
in-house analytical capabilities allow for quick and reliable in-process testing to guarantee the
compliance of our products with both standard catalog and unique custom specifications.

advanced precursors. These additions support vapor-phase deposition, sol-gel synthesis, and
metal-organic formulation strategies across a wide range of applications. From rare earths to
transition metals, each compound is manufactured to meet demanding purity and performance standards.

# More about us

Quantum Sweden Innovation Platform (QSIP) is a Swedish initiative to stimulate, foster, and promote
quantum technology innovation to support the emergence and growth of a Swedish, globally competitive
and attractive industry within and by means of quantum technology.
The platform will provide both individual and general support activities to enable increased
innovation, application development and commercialization of quantum technology.

# Putting photons to work

[hero logo]
[Learn more][9]
[Learn more][10]

#### Press Release

### **Quantum Computing Inc. Appoints Susan Hunt as Chief Revenue Officer and Creates Chief Product
### Officer Role to Accelerate Commercial Growth**

[Read the press release][11]

### Welcoming a new team

QCi is proud to welcome NHanced, NuCrypt, Freedom Photonics, EM4, and Optogration to the QCi family
to accelerate our transition from technology innovation to scalable manufacturing, reinforcing our
mission to put quantum-enabled solutions into the hands of people.

### NHanced

At NHanced Semiconductors we transform bleeding-edge designs into state-of-the-art 3DICs and 2.5D
assemblies.

[Visit their site][12]

### NuCrypt

NuCrypt develops inter-disciplinary technologies for emerging applications in communications and
metrology.

[Visit their site][13]

### Freedom Photonics

Freedom Photonics is a leader in design, development and manufacturing of unique and innovative
photonics components, modules and subsystems.

[Visit their site][14]

### EM4

EM4 is a leader in high-performance photonics components, modules and subassemblies with a long
heritage as a preferred supplier for leading aerospace and defense contractors around the globe.

[Visit their site][15]

### Optogration

Optogration is a leader in advanced photodetectors and detector-based components with extremely high
sensitivity and wide dynamic range for mission-critical applications.

[Visit their site][16]

## Who we are

At QCi, we build practical, scalable, room-temperature quantum photonics products that harness the
quantum nature of light to capture data, compute complex information, and securely communicate
across networks.

Our integrated quantum photonic solutions are engineered to solve real-world challenges by saving
time, reducing costs, and simplifying critical decisions.

We transform advanced quantum science into powerful tools that help people and businesses focus on
what matters most.

[vision]

## Whom we work with

We are proud to have partnered and collaborated with various industry partners, big and small.

## About QCi

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that
provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to
operate room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core
technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing,
artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

### Publications

QCi has technical talent with a range of expertise that have been publishing papers, patents, and
other scientific material. The publications fall within the categories of quantum computing,
reservoir computing, cybersecrity, biomedical imaging, remote sensing, and quantum communication.

[See publications][17]

### Join our team

We are always looking to hire world-class talent who are passionate about developing disruptive
technology that will have a positive impact on the world. Does that sound like you? Join us.

[Apply now][18]

[

Self-Forcing Braided Sleeve Gripper: A Soft Robotics Approach to Offshore Conductor Removal

][9]
Master thesis (2026) - [C. Dielas][10], [J. Jovanova][11], J. Breukels, [V.G. Kortman][12], [H.L.
McQuillan][13], [Jieun Yang][14]

Offshore decommissioning is accelerating asageing oil and gas infrastructure reaches the end of its
service life. In theNorth Sea alone, over 2,650 wells are scheduled between 2025 and 2034, and
wellplug and abandonment accounted for 49% of decommissioning expenditure on the UKContinental Shelf
in 2024. Within this scope, conductor removal, the extractionof large-diameter vertical steel pipes
connecting subsea wells to surfacefacilities, remains a persistent operational bottleneck. Current
practice relieson the cut-and-pull method, in which the entire lifting load is transferredthrough a
single conductor cross-section. Its applicability is thereforegoverned by the structural condition
of that cross-section, as corroded casingsand degraded connections may not sustain the concentrated
load.

This thesis proposes a compliant grippingmechanism that distributes the lifting load over the outer
conductor surface,and examines whether it scales to the multi-tonne loads of conductor removal,
aregime far beyond the small-scale applications to which soft robotic grippershave been confined.
Following a literature study into soft gripping methods anda conceptual design process, four
concepts were evaluated, from which a braidedconstriction sleeve gripper was selected. Its defining
property is aself-forcing mechanism, in which the weight of the conductor tightens the braidaround
its surface, so that a heavier load produces a stronger grip.

An analytical model relates the braidgeometry to the holding capacity, which grows exponentially
with adimensionless self-forcing coefficient. This coefficient is the product of thefriction
coefficient and a geometric coefficient scaling with the conductorradius and the square of the
number of braid turns, and inversely with thegripping length. The capacity is supplied passively by
the weight of a bottomring, requiring no continuous actuation. A parametric campaign across
twelveconfigurations, each tested five times, supported the model within the rangeexamined. The
measured capacity scaled linearly with the ring weight at fixedgeometry, rose far more steeply with
the geometric coefficient than preloadfriction alone permits, following the exponential form
characteristic ofself-forcing, and followed the predicted direction for each geometric
parametervaried in isolation. A single friction coefficient of approximately 0.135reproduced the
measured capacity across differing geometries, supporting thecontact assumptions. The most tightly
braided configuration sustained more than75 kg without slipping, giving a payload-to-self-weight
ratio of at least 337:1against 16:1 at the baseline.Applied to the NorthCormorant platform, the
model yields an early-phase full-scale design employinga steel wire rope braid of seven turns over a
gripping length of 14 metres,preloaded by a 10 tonne bottom ring. Under a conservative design
frictioncoefficient of 0.10, the holding capacity reaches approximately 18,800 kNagainst a design
lifting weight of 634 kN per conductor section. Slip istherefore not the governing constraint, which
is set instead by the ropestrength at the top ring connection and by the deployment of the braid. To
theauthor's knowledge, this constitutes the first compliant gripping conceptmodelled, experimentally
supported, and dimensioned for offshore removals atthe multi-tonne scale. ... Read more

[

Steering the story

][15]

Assessing narrative-shift potential in mobility-focused urban living labs

Master thesis (2026) - [J.P. Wendling][16], [C. Wehrmann][17], [S.M. Flipse][18], [U. Pesch][19],
[J. van Keulen][20]
Mobility transitions are shaped not only by infrastructure, technology and policy, but also by
narratives: shared understandings, in this case about what forms of mobility are considered normal,
desirable, feasible and acceptable. These days, dominant mobility narratives are often car-centred,
which can limit the adoption of more sustainable mobility practices. Urban living labs may offer
conditions in which alternative mobility narratives can be experienced, discussed and developed,
because they combine real-world experimentation, local embedding, stakeholder collaboration and
participant involvement. However, it remains unclear how the narrative-shift potential of
mobility-focused urban living labs can be assessed or strengthened in practice.
This thesis investigates how the narrative-shift potential of mobility-focused urban living labs can
be assessed and translates this into a practical design-support tool for organisers. Narrative-shift
potential is defined as the extent to which a living lab contains theoretically grounded design
conditions that may support participants or relevant actors in engaging with, reflecting on and
possibly adopting or diffusing an alternative mobility narrative. The thesis does not measure actual
participant-level narrative change.
The thesis consists of two main sections: a research and design section. The research section is
aimed at answering the research question: “How can the narrative-shift potential of mobility-focused
urban living labs be assessed?”. The design section is aimed at answering the design question: “How
can the assessment of narrative-shift potential be translated into a practical design-support tool
for organisers of mobility-focused urban living labs?”.
The research combines a targeted literature review, rubric development and qualitative multiple-case
study analysis. Literature on mobility narratives, narrative persuasion and urban living labs is
synthesised into six mechanisms associated with narrative-shift potential: deep immersion,
reflexivity, participatory approach, socio-spatial relevance, network nurturing and social network
inclusion. These mechanisms are operationalised into a ULL characterisation rubric and applied to
three real-world cases: GEMINI, ALTHEA and sCOOL2walk.
The analysis shows that across cases, socio-spatial relevance, deep immersion and network nurturing
are relatively strong, while reflexivity and social network inclusion are less deliberately
developed. This suggests that mobility-focused urban living labs may already contain implicit
narrative-shift potential, but that this potential is not always intentionally recognised or
designed for.
The design phase translates these findings into the ULL Optimisation Tool, consisting of a ULL
framing canvas, assessment rubric, mechanism prompt cards and optimisation canvas. A validation step
led to the addition of a living lab fit check, a clearer distinction between target groups, users
and enabling actors, and an explicit access check before participant-facing interventions are
selected. The final output is a workshop-based tool that helps organisers define the intended
narrative shift, assess mechanism expression, prioritise improvement opportunities and translate
them into design interventions.
The tool helps organisers make narrative-shift potential explicit and identify context-specific
opportunities for strengthening it. The thesis contributes a theoretically grounded and practically
usable approach for assessing and designing conditions associated with narrative-shift potential in
mobility-focused urban living labs. ... Read more

service life. In theNorth Sea alone, over 2,650 wells are scheduled between 2025 and 2034, and
wellplug and abandonment accounted for 49% of decommissioning expenditure on the UKContinental Shelf
in 2024. Within this scope, conductor removal, the extractionof large-diameter vertical steel pipes
connecting subsea wells to surfacefacilities, remains a persistent operational bottleneck. Current
practice relieson the cut-and-pull method, in which the entire lifting load is transferredthrough a
single conductor cross-section. Its applicability is thereforegoverned by the structural condition
of that cross-section, as corroded casingsand degraded connections may not sustain the concentrated
load.

This thesis proposes a compliant grippingmechanism that distributes the lifting load over the outer
conductor surface,and examines whether it scales to the multi-tonne loads of conductor removal,
aregime far beyond the small-scale applications to which soft robotic grippershave been confined.
Following a literature study into soft gripping methods anda conceptual design process, four
concepts were evaluated, from which a braidedconstriction sleeve gripper was selected. Its defining
property is aself-forcing mechanism, in which the weight of the conductor tightens the braidaround
its surface, so that a heavier load produces a stronger grip.

An analytical model relates the braidgeometry to the holding capacity, which grows exponentially
with adimensionless self-forcing coefficient. This coefficient is the product of thefriction
coefficient and a geometric coefficient scaling with the conductorradius and the square of the
number of braid turns, and inversely with thegripping length. The capacity is supplied passively by
the weight of a bottomring, requiring no continuous actuation. A parametric campaign across
twelveconfigurations, each tested five times, supported the model within the rangeexamined. The
measured capacity scaled linearly with the ring weight at fixedgeometry, rose far more steeply with
the geometric coefficient than preloadfriction alone permits, following the exponential form
characteristic ofself-forcing, and followed the predicted direction for each geometric
parametervaried in isolation. A single friction coefficient of approximately 0.135reproduced the
measured capacity across differing geometries, supporting thecontact assumptions. The most tightly

ratio of at least 337:1against 16:1 at the baseline.

Steering the story

][15]

Assessing narrative-shift potential in mobility-focused urban living labs

Master thesis (2026) - [J.P. Wendling][16], [C. Wehrmann][17], [S.M. Flipse][18], [U. Pesch][19],
[J. van Keulen][20]
Mobility transitions are shaped not only by infrastructure, technology and policy, but also by
narratives: shared understandings, in this case about what forms of mobility are considered normal,
desirable, feasible and acceptable. These days, dominant mobility narratives are often car-centred,
which can limit the adoption of more sustainable mobility practices. Urban living labs may offer
conditions in which alternative mobility narratives can be experienced, discussed and developed,
because they combine real-world experimentation, local embedding, stakeholder collaboration and
participant involvement. However, it remains unclear how the narrative-shift potential of
mobility-focused urban living labs can be assessed or strengthened in practice.
This thesis investigates how the narrative-shift potential of mobility-focused urban living labs can
be assessed and translates this into a practical design-support tool for organisers. Narrative-shift
potential is defined as the extent to which a living lab contains theoretically grounded design
conditions that may support participants or relevant actors in engaging with, reflecting on and
possibly adopting or diffusing an alternative mobility narrative. The thesis does not measure actual
participant-level narrative change.
The thesis consists of two main sections: a research and design section. The research section is
aimed at answering the research question: “How can the narrative-shift potential of mobility-focused
urban living labs be assessed?”. The design section is aimed at answering the design question: “How
can the assessment of narrative-shift potential be translated into a practical design-support tool
for organisers of mobility-focused urban living labs?”.
The research combines a targeted literature review, rubric development and qualitative multiple-case
study analysis. Literature on mobility narratives, narrative persuasion and urban living labs is
synthesised into six mechanisms associated with narrative-shift potential: deep immersion,
reflexivity, participatory approach, socio-spatial relevance, network nurturing and social network
inclusion. These mechanisms are operationalised into a ULL characterisation rubric and applied to
three real-world cases: GEMINI, ALTHEA and sCOOL2walk.
The analysis shows that across cases, socio-spatial relevance, deep immersion and network nurturing
are relatively strong, while reflexivity and social network inclusion are less deliberately
developed. This suggests that mobility-focused urban living labs may already contain implicit
narrative-shift potential, but that this potential is not always intentionally recognised or
designed for.
The design phase translates these findings into the ULL Optimisation Tool, consisting of a ULL
framing canvas, assessment rubric, mechanism prompt cards and optimisation canvas. A validation step
led to the addition of a living lab fit check, a clearer distinction between target groups, users
and enabling actors, and an explicit access check before participant-facing interventions are
selected. The final output is a workshop-based tool that helps organisers define the intended
narrative shift, assess mechanism expression, prioritise improvement opportunities and translate
them into design interventions.
The tool helps organisers make narrative-shift potential explicit and identify context-specific
opportunities for strengthening it. The thesis contributes a theoretically grounded and practically
usable approach for assessing and designing conditions associated with narrative-shift potential in
mobility-focused urban living labs. ... Read more

**embedded systems**, **renewable** systems through interdisciplinary research and hands-on

  providing 6H-SiC and 4H-SiC crystal substrates for the production of high-frequency, high-power,
  high-temperature, and radiation-resistant electronic devices. As market demand for
  higher-performance electronic devices continues to grow, ZMSH has invested in research and
  development, resulting in the launch of a new generation of 4H/6H-P 3C-N SiC crystal substrates.
  This product integrates traditional 4H/6H polytype SiC substrates with new 3C-N SiC films,
  offering significant performance enhancements for next-generation high-power and high-frequency
  electronic devices. Analysis of Existing Products: 6H-SiC and 4H-SiC Crystal Substrates Product
  Features Crystal Structure: Both 6H-SiC and 4H-SiC have hexagonal crystal structures. The 6H type
  has slightly lower electron mobility and a narrower bandgap, while the 4H type provides higher
  electron mobility and a wider bandgap (3.2 eV), making it ideal for high-frequency and high-power
  devices. Conductivity Type: Supports N-type or semi-insulating, catering to various device design
  requirements. Thermal Conductivity: SiC substrates offer thermal conductivity between 3.2–4.9
  W/cm·K, ensuring effective heat dissipation, which is critical for high-temperature electronics.
  Mechanical Properties: With high hardness (Mohs hardness of 9.2), SiC substrates offer mechanical
  stability, making them suitable for wear-resistant and mechanically demanding applications.
  Applications: These substrates are primarily used in power electronic devices, high-frequency
  devices, and some high-temperature and radiation-resistant applications. Technical Limitations
  Although 6H-SiC and 4H-SiC have performed well in the market, their performance still falls short
  in certain high-frequency, high-power, and high-temperature applications. Challenges such as high
  defect rates, limited electron mobility, and bandgap constraints mean that the performance of
  these materials has not yet fully met the needs of next-generation electronic devices. Therefore,
  the market demands higher-performance, lower-defect materials to enhance device efficiency and
  stability. Innovation in the New Product: 4H/6H-P 3C-N SiC Crystal Substrates To address the
  limitations of traditional 6H and 4H-SiC materials, ZMSH has introduced the innovative 4H/6H-P
  3C-N SiC crystal substrate. By epitaxially growing 3C-N SiC films on 4H/6H-SiC substrates, the new
  product significantly improves material performance.     Technological Advancements Polytype
  Integration Technology: Using chemical vapor deposition (CVD) technology, 3C-SiC films are
  precisely epitaxially grown on 4H/6H-SiC substrates, reducing lattice mismatch and defect density,
  thus improving the structural integrity of the material. Improved Electron Mobility: Compared to
  traditional 4H/6H-SiC, the 3C-SiC crystal offers higher electron mobility, making the new material
  more suitable for high-frequency applications. Higher Breakdown Voltage: Electrical performance
  tests show significant improvement in breakdown voltage, making the product more suitable for
  high-power applications. Low Defect Rate: Optimized growth conditions have significantly reduced
  crystal defects and dislocations, enabling the material to maintain long-term stability in
  high-pressure and high-temperature environments. Optoelectronic Integration: 3C-SiC has unique
  optoelectronic properties, particularly suitable for ultraviolet detectors and other
  optoelectronic applications, expanding the product's application range. Key Advantages of the New
  Product Higher Electron Mobility and Breakdown Voltage: Compared to 6H and 4H-SiC, the 3C-N SiC
  film allows electronic devices to perform more stably under high-frequency and high-power
  conditions, with improved transmission efficiency and longer device lifespan. Enhanced Thermal
  Conductivity and Stability: The new SiC material exhibits improved thermal conductivity and
  stability at high temperatures, making it ideal for applications above 1000°C. Integrated
  Optoelectronic Properties: The optoelectronic characteristics of 3C-SiC further enhance the
  competitiveness of SiC substrates in the optoelectronic device market, especially in ultraviolet
  detection and optical sensor applications. Chemical Stability and Corrosion Resistance: The new
  SiC material has increased stability in chemical corrosion and oxidation environments, making it

## Empowering Scholarly Journals
## to Publish in a Smarter Way

Science Alert offers a comprehensive suite of digital publishing tools and platforms that cover
every stage of the publishing process. This includes managing and hosting content, conducting
e-commerce, overseeing access and identity, tracking manuscript submissions, and analyzing data.

#### [Rigorous Peer-Review][12]

Friendly and constructive peer-review of your paper by specialized referees.

#### [High Standards][13]

Rapid production combined with expert copyediting, proofreading, and final presentation.

#### [Impact Metrics][14]

Keep track of the impact of your research with article-level data.

#### [Retain Copyright][15]

We use the Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license that allows the author to retain copyright.

## International Partnership

[JournalPedia] [CrossRef] [ALPSP] [Journals on the Web] [The ACSE] [AEB] [LiveDNA] [iThenticate]

### Currently hosting **more than 50,000** fully open-access articles

Science Alert is an AI-supported leading journal-hosting platform designed to serve readers and
publishers. Our publishing infrastructure is designed by experts after communicating with
researchers of various disciplines and provides different options to read and share quality research
work around the globe.
* [01 Global Reach ][16]
  
  Our network of trusted journals is visited by 4.2 MILLION users*
* [02 Learn from Peers ][17]
  
  Reach out to our experienced editors and acquire the skills to convey your research to your
  intended audience effectively.
* [03 Innovative Solutions ][18]
  
  We create and implement cutting-edge technology to aid in advancements and foster fresh
  perspectives in open-access publishing.

## Services

Science Alert is committed to providing advanced online hosting and technological solutions to
publishers. We are continuously striving to design and develop technological solutions to make the
publishing journey fast, secure, easier, and more convenient.

#### [Our Journals][19]

Find out more about our world-leading peer-reviewed open-access journals, including the journal’s
specific information and guidelines.

#### [For Authors][20]

This section will provide all the essential information for authors, and we recommend that you take
the time to read them before submitting a contribution.

#### [Librarian Portal][21]

We have developed a Librarian Portal to enable you to access our online content in a way that suits
your budget and users' needs.

#### [For Societies][22]

This section will provide information about how we help scholarly societies and the exclusive
benefits of publishing journals with us.

#### [For Referees][23]

To ensure research integrity, we maintain a list of distinguished and qualified experts to aid in
the review of journals utilizing Science Alert services.

#### [ASCI Database][24]

Providing an extensive index of trusted and significant research data/breakthroughs across various
disciplines to drive research strategies globally.

### Submit Manuscript

We are providing advanced publishing services with an expert support team to facilitate authors with
a comprehensive suite of high-impact journals in all areas of science, technology, and medicine.

[Submit Now][25]

dedicated to publishing cutting-edge research work on all aspects of dairy sciences.

## Our Expertise

[ [Close up of a car tire on the highway with a gold filter] ][56]

### [ Automotive ][57]

With automotive manufacturing operations found in every corner of the world, first, second and third
tier automotive suppliers, EMSs (Electronic Manufacturing Services), and contract manufacturers
often have needs for components in shortage or only available with long lead times. VRG Components
fills their supply gaps quickly & efficiently.

[Go to industry][58]
[ [Hand touching a medical electronics touch screen with a yellow filter] ][59]

### [ Medical Electronics ][60]

Medical device manufacturers use an extensive variety of electronic parts. When a crucial component
is unavailable from their primary suppliers, they turn to us. Our focus on delivering first quality
components backed by our AS9120 certified processes provide the peace of mind these manufacturers
demand.

[Go to industry][61]
[ [Automotive highway at night with blurred lights from cars and a gold filter] ][62]

### [ Transportation ][63]

Mass media communications systems in modern public transportation (rail cars, buses, terminals,
highways) utilize a vast number of electronic components. Several suppliers manufacturing these
systems exclusively turn to VRG when they need hard-to-find components.

[Go to industry][64]
[ [Technician operating a machinery operations panel with a gold filter] ][65]

### [ Machinery ][66]

Machinery manufacturing is a vital industrial sector that uses more and more electronic components
as processes evolve - especially as we embrace IoT (internet Of Things). Maintaining tried and true
manufacturing systems sometimes requires obtaining components that can be especially hard to find.

We are proud to be a 3X honoree of the prestigious Inc. 5000! ## VRG Components Unveils New Brand Identity Our new brand identity captures our reputation for solving global supply chain challenges with unmatched speed and precision. ## Make finding crucial components our challenge, not yours. We specialize in global sourcing services for new, allocated, and end-of-life electronic components from a wide range of leading manufacturers. ## We are not your typical supplier ## And that's by design. Expect unmatched speed to turn around quotes in minutes, not hours. We get it. When you need that illusive part, you don't have time to waste. You want answers & you want them quickly. ## Our AS9120 Certifications ## Set us apart. Way apart. VRG Components is unlike other independent distributors you might know. Where other companies may lack quality standards, we are committed to quality and maintain distinguishing AS9120 certifications. Enter a Part Number: Search ## Our Expertise [ [Close up of a car tire on the highway with a gold filter] ][56] ### [ Automotive ][57] With automotive manufacturing operations found in every corner of the world, first, second and third tier automotive suppliers, EMSs (Electronic Manufacturing Services), and contract manufacturers often have needs for components in shortage or only available with long lead times. VRG Components fills their supply gaps quickly & efficiently. [Go to industry][58] [ [Hand touching a medical electronics touch screen with a yellow filter] ][59] ### [ Medical Electronics ][60] Medical device manufacturers use an extensive variety of electronic parts. When a crucial component is unavailable from their primary suppliers, they turn to us. Our focus on delivering first quality components backed by our AS9120 certified processes provide the peace of mind these manufacturers demand. [Go to industry][61] [ [Automotive highway at night with blurred lights from cars and a gold filter] ][62] ### [ Transportation ][63] Mass media communications systems in modern public transportation (rail cars, buses, terminals, highways) utilize a vast number of electronic components. Several suppliers manufacturing these systems exclusively turn to VRG when they need hard-to-find components. [Go to industry][64] [ [Technician operating a machinery operations panel with a gold filter] ][65] ### [ Machinery ][66] Machinery manufacturing is a vital industrial sector that uses more and more electronic components as processes evolve - especially as we embrace IoT (internet Of Things). Maintaining tried and true manufacturing systems sometimes requires obtaining components that can be especially hard to find. [Go to industry][67] FIND YOUR COMPONENTS Browse through hundreds of thousands of top-quality electrical components and spare parts. [Start Your Search][68] [Contact us][69] ## About Us ### VRG Components… Not your Typical Supplier. VRG Components® is an industry-leading, AS9120 certified, independent worldwide distributor of electronic components, semiconductors, and network components from hundreds of product manufacturers. We specialize in global sourcing services for new, allocated, end-of-life, last-time buy (LTB), and long lead time electronic components from a wide range of leading brands. VRG Components is unlike other independent distributors you might know. Where other companies may lack quality standards, we are committed to quality and maintain AS9120 certifications. Our sales team speaks your language, from German to Spanish, and we work hard to build meaningful and long-term relationships with our customers and vendors located in every corner of the world. Our customers love doing business with VRG, and we value being there for you when you need us. ### Make finding crucial components our challenge, not yours – it’s what we do. Allow us to be your choice partner in sourcing shortage and difficult-to-find parts today. Where competitors are slow to deliver or don’t at all, we go above and beyond for you, our customer. And we’re different in that we specialize in finding parts no one else can. We’re not like other distributors and are proud of it. Now, we know that component sourcing can be challenging. VRG Components, with over 50 years of industry expertise, a multi-lingual sourcing team, and unmatched access to exclusive global inventory, is uniquely positioned to serve your needs. [**Learn more about how we do it in this video.**][70] ### Did you know we’re committed to turning around quick quotes? VRG Components is committed to fast, accurate quotes and top-tier service. Reach out to your sales executive for a quick quote on a part you need, within 30 minutes or less. Just have your manufacturer name and part number ready. **[Learn more about our unrivaled service offerings.][71]** 50 + Years of Experience 500 + Manufacturers 50 + Product Lines 50,000 + Parts Available #### Pierre C. The service is really irreproachable. #### Philippe P. VERY SATISFIED! ## We specialize in delivering We regularly source a wide range of products from leading manufacturers and approved vendors around the world. In total we can secure electronic components from over 500 manufacturers. ## Waveguide optics and enterprise smart glasses

With 30 years in wearable technology, Vuzix develops waveguide optics for device makers and builds
smart glasses for enterprise use.

OEM & Waveguide Technology

### Optical platforms for device makers

Vuzix designs and manufactures waveguide optics, display systems, and OEM platforms for companies
building or white-labeling smart glasses.

## Search in WebThesis

[Advanced search][14]

Webthesis portal gives access to the electronic archive of Politecnico's Master's degree theses and
meritorious theses in Architecture.

You can find in full text format:
* Master's degree theses of the courses in Cinema and Media Engineering, Electrical Engineering,
  Territorial, Urban, Environmental and Landscape Planning discussed in July 2017 (Academic Year
  2016/17);
* Most of the Master's degree theses discussed in the graduation session of October and December
  2017 (AY 2017/18);
* Master's theses of Politecnico discussed from 2018 on (AY 2017/2018).

Webthesis includes also records with abstracts for:
* The meritorious theses in Architecture discussed since 1996;
* All the Master's theses in Architecture discussed since 2010 with bibliography, index of chapters
  and tables.

Bibliographic data of the theses delivered to the Registrar's Office in electronic format and not
authorized to public consultation are also included (full-text not available).

Refer to the [contact][15] page to request changes to the accessibility of the theses.

# [Yue YU][1]

Sylvia's personal website

[View My GitHub Profile][2]

[NICE Hiking experience!]

## Hallo! This is Yue YU（俞越）!

I am currently a postdoc at [University of California, Berkeley][3] and supervised by Prof. Mengjie
Yu. Before that, I spent six years at [CUHK][4] as a postgraduate student. Pls kindly check my
latest [CV][5].

During my postgraduate studies, I focus on design, fabrication, and characterization of
high-performance micro/nanodevices on various integrated photonic platforms including lithium
niobate on insulator, silicon on insulator, silica, etc. My works can be divided into following two
parts:

### (Ⅰ) Ultralow-loss integrated photonics on lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) platform
1. By applying the principle of “bound states in the continuum (BICs)”, high-performance integrated
   photonic devices were developed on a new hybrid photonic architecture at near-visible
   wavelengths, which allows confining and guiding photons using low-refractive-index waveguides
   without etching of the single-crystal substrate. Based on this strategy, a series of fundamental
   components, including waveguides, microcavities, power splitter, Mach-Zehnder interferometers,
   multimode directional couplers, were demonstrated on this platform. This work has been published
   in [[Adv. Opt. Mater. 9, 2100060 (2021)][6]].
2. On-chip arrayed waveguide gratings (AWGs) with the best reported performance yet was achieved on
   lithium niobate integrated photonic platforms. The demonstrated AWGs will enable new applications
   in high-capacity telecommunication, high-resolution imaging, and high-speed sensing. This work
   has been published in [[ACS Photonics 9, 3253–3259 (2022)][7]].
3. Acousto-optic modulation was explored on this platform to leverage the strong piezoelectric
   effect on LiNbO3. This research results have been published in [[Nanophotonics 10, 4323
   (2021)][8]]. This efficient acousto-optic modulation was further utilized to build a on-chip
   multiple passband microwave photonic (MWP) filter. Compared with former MWP filters, ours feature
   a high resolution, compact device footprint, and low energy consumption, which can be applied to
   television, mobile, satellite communications, or radar applications, where the center frequency
   is usually fixed and a narrow bandwidth is desired. This work has been published in [[Laser &
   Photon. Rev. 18, 2300385 (2024)][9]].
4. Second-harmonic-generation was also explored on this platform considering the strong optical
   nonlinearity of LiNbO3. . Due to the opposite thermo-optic coefficients of the polymer and
   lithium niobate, this our structure shows a large thermal stability with a wavelength shift of
   only 1.7 nm from 25°C to 100°C. This work has been published in [[Laser & Photon. Rev. 16,
   2100429 (2022)][10]].
5. Due to the generic mechanism of BIC, this architecture can be extended directly to other
   functional materials and easily integrated with 2D materials for different applications in
   optical communications, nonlinear optics at the single-photon level, and scalable photonic
   quantum information processors. Photon emission by sandwiching a monolayer WS2 between a
   BIC-based photonic waveguide and lithium niobate substrate was demonstrated, which holds great
   promise for building on-chip quantum light sources without fabrication challenges. This work havs
   been published in [[Nano Lett. 23, 3209-3216 (2023)][11]].
6. For those who interested on BIC-based etchless PICs, a detailed tutorial including theoretical
   analysis, numerical simulation, and fabrication processes of low-refractive-index PICs was
